newsitem.title: ESTONIA: VIISNURK LISTING NOT EXPECTED TO BE APPROVED.
newsitem.headline: VIISNURK LISTING NOT EXPECTED TO BE APPROVED.

text.p: Viisnurk, one of the world's largest cross-country ski makers, is not expected to get its application for a listing on the Tallinn stock exchange approved on Tuesday, Hansa Investments said.

"The commission may wish to confirm that the required amount of shares are publicly traded before approving the listing," Kristel Tumm, associate director of Hansa Investments, which is handling the issue and the listing, told Reuters.
"As the share issue only finished on Monday, the final results of the issue are not known yet," she added.
The stock exchange listing commission is to meet today. Viisnurk submitted its application for listing in mid-May.
Viisnurk, seen as an attractive stock by analysts, was oversubscribed by more than eight times according to preliminary data.
It was offering 90,000 new shares at 130 kroons with a nominal value of 10 kroons which attracted strong local interest.
"We only offered the stock locally as we wanted to ensure that we had the widest possible base of owners to conform to the stock market listing requirements," Tumm said.
But she added that many of the larger existing shareholders have exercised their priority purchase rights.
